events.title: DNS tampering briefly defaces Witza Aug 27; Omniscient confirms no data stolen
events.description: On August 27th someone made DNS changes for HackForums and Witza, briefly defacing Witza; Omniscient fixed the issue and confirmed no information was stolen.

events.title: New 'Legalize It' award added for $50 BTC; 25% goes to NORML.org
events.description: Omniscient added a 'Legalize It' award available for $50 BTC in support of cannabis legalization, with 25% of donations going to NORML.org.

events.title: Sept 12 maintenance: junk forums cleared, post recount (~1M posts removed)
events.description: On September 12th HF was down 45 minutes for maintenance; Omniscient cleared junk forums, deleted users, and ran a post recount, removing approximately one million posts.

events.title: New $1,000 one-time Grand Amethyst donation award; four buy on day one
events.description: Omniscient added a new $1,000 one-time 'Grand Amethyst' donation award; four members purchased it on day one, and Master Donator may become a $500 one-time purchase.

events.title: Polymath runs Polybot AI chatbot contest with hidden code prizes
events.description: Polymath ran a Polybot AI chatbot contest with hidden codes for prizes ranging from upgrades to group invites; the original thread was closed after 1,600 replies due to a glitch and Lani created a follow-up.
